- [ ] New environment
- [ ] Update existing environment
- [ ] Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] Tested with VirtualBox (`vagrant up`)
- [ ] Tested with VMware (`vagrant up --provider=vmware_desktop`)
- [ ] Both providers defined in Vagrantfile
- [ ] README.md present in environment directory with URLs and credentials
- [ ] Root README.md catalog table updated (if new environment)
- [ ] No `.vagrant/` directory or generated files committed
- [ ] Software versions pinned in provisioning scripts
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
